WITH team_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    AVG(w) as avg_wins,
    AVG(CASE WHEN g IS NOT NULL AND l IS NOT NULL AND l > 0
             THEN (g - l) / CAST(l AS FLOAT) 
             ELSE NULL 
        END) as avg_win_loss_ratio
  FROM manager_half
  GROUP BY team_id
),
mean_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_mean_wins
  FROM team_stats
)
SELECT 
  ts.team_id,
  ts.avg_wins,
  ts.avg_win_loss_ratio,
  ts.avg_wins - ms.overall_mean_wins as gap
FROM team_stats ts
CROSS JOIN mean_stats ms
WHERE ts.avg_wins > ms.overall_mean_wins
ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
